tasks.label: JLink reset mcu
args: echo device ${config:device} > flash.jlink && echo si SWD >> flash.jlink && echo speed 4000 >> flash.jlink && echo r >> flash.jlink && echo h >> flash.jlink && echo q >> flash.jlink && JLinkExe -nogui 1 -CommandFile flash.jlink 1>/dev/null && echo SUCCESS || echo FAIL

tasks.label: JLink erase mcu
args: echo device ${config:device} > flash.jlink && echo si SWD >> flash.jlink && echo speed 4000 >> flash.jlink && echo r >> flash.jlink && echo h >> flash.jlink && echo erase >>flash.jlink && echo q >> flash.jlink && JLinkExe -nogui 1 -CommandFile flash.jlink 1>/dev/null && echo SUCCESS || echo FAIL

tasks.label: JLink flash mcu
args: echo device ${config:device} > flash.jlink && echo si SWD >> flash.jlink && echo speed 4000 >> flash.jlink && echo r >> flash.jlink && echo h >> flash.jlink && echo loadfile build/${command:cmake.buildType}/${workspaceFolderBasename}.elf >> flash.jlink && echo r >> flash.jlink && echo q >> flash.jlink && JLinkExe -nogui 1 -CommandFile flash.jlink 1>/dev/null && echo SUCCESS || echo FAIL
